title: Security Fortification, Cross-Browser Stats Fix & AI Performance Tuning
content:
This update focuses on deep security fortification, a complete reconstruction of the Firefox network statistics engine, and extreme performance tuning for the AI modules. We've eliminated critical DoS vectors and ensured seamless data consistency across all platforms.

🦊 1. Firefox Statistics Engine Reconstruction
- Hybrid Statistics Architecture: Completely resolved the issue where blocked counts always displayed as 0 on Firefox. By utilizing the legacy webRequest API purely for read-only observation alongside DNR, we now achieve real-time, accurate block counting identical to Chrome.
- Dynamic Ruleset Splitting: Addressed Firefox's 30,000 static rule quota limitation by dynamically splitting large rulesets into smaller chunks (1500 rules/block). This prevents the browser from dropping the entire ruleset due to quota exhaustion.

🔒 2. Deep Security & Vulnerability Patches
- Temporary Whitelist Crash Fix: Fixed a critical ReferenceError when removing temporary whitelists, ensuring complete consistency between UI state and underlying network rules. Also added an automated background purge to clean expired session rules every 10 minutes.
- DoS Prevention: Implemented strict payload validation and batch limits for third-party host reporting. Malicious pages can no longer flood the background Service Worker with tens of thousands of domains, completely preventing CPU exhaustion and memory overflow.
- Threat Intel Signature Upgrade: Transitioned the threat intelligence signature verification to Canonical JSON, preventing parsing ambiguity attacks. Introduced a multi-public-key dictionary to support smooth key rotation. Tightened CI/CD permissions to prevent supply chain poisoning.

🚀 3. AI & Performance Optimization
- Stack Overflow Prevention: Replaced the dangerous Math.max(...) spread operator in the AI feature extractor with standard loop iteration. This completely eliminates stack overflow crashes caused by extremely long malicious URLs (e.g., massive Base64 data).
- Levenshtein Pruning: Added length-difference pruning and early termination to the Levenshtein distance calculation, massively reducing CPU overhead for phishing detection.
- Model Fetch Throttling: Introduced a 6-hour hard throttle with ETag (If-None-Match) negotiation for cloud model updates, eliminating redundant network requests during every MV3 Service Worker cold start.

🎨 4. UI & Experience Improvements
- Real-time State Sync: Fixed the Sidepanel UI desynchronization issue. The protection toggle now instantly reflects the correct 'Paused/Protection On' status, eliminating the need to close and reopen the sidebar.
- Repository & Fuzzing: Introduced Rust Proptest for core URL parsers and added an Intelligence Safety Gate to prevent mass false-positive updates.

title: Massive AI Performance Leap & Multi-Signal False-Positive Prevention System
content:
This update is the most significant performance and security overhaul in DewSecure's history. We've not only completely resolved the computational bottlenecks inherent in the MV3 architecture but also established a global crowdsourced threat intelligence network.

⚡ 1. Revolutionary AI Inference Engine Speedup (48x)
- Sparse Feature Extraction: Completely refactored the AI feature extraction process, abandoning the practice of constructing 16,418-dimensional dense arrays for every evaluation. Single inference time dropped drastically from 383µs to 7.9µs (a 48x speedup).
- 32-bit Hash Optimization: Replaced the underlying BigInt hash operations with 32-bit Math.imul. While guaranteeing 100% mathematical equivalence, it completely eliminated the expensive large-number arithmetic overhead.
- Persistent Model Caching: Introduced chrome.storage.session to prevent redundant database reads and re-inferences after the Service Worker suspends. Memory bloat and stuttering issues in the MV3 environment are completely terminated.

🛡️ 2. Blocking Strategy Refactored: Farewell to Single-Point False Positives
- Multi-Signal Cross-Verification: Abandoned the aggressive strategy of blocking at the network layer based solely on model confidence. Now, it requires at least 3 independent signals: [Model Confidence] + [Cross-site Reference Frequency] + [Suspicious Feature Match] to trigger a hard network-layer block.
- Silent Processing: Suspicious domains that do not meet the 3-signal threshold are moved to a local silent candidate pool, no longer interfering with legitimate website functions.
- Precise Allowlist Expansion: Fixed issues where sites like Lazada and Speedtest suffered from white screens, missing images, or broken buttons due to their core CDNs being misjudged.

🌐 3. Established a K-Anonymity Crowdsourced Threat Intelligence Network
- Silent Reporting Mechanism: Added a background silent reporting module. The extension will daily aggregate and report locally highly suspicious candidate domains (100% anonymized, containing zero browsing history) using K-Anonymity.
- Automatic Immunity: Once the cloud receives consensus from over 100 distinct users, the domain is automatically added to the official blocklist and pushed via OTA. This achieves zero user disturbance and automatic false-positive prevention.

🎨 4. Page Cleaning & Experience Optimization
- Farewell to Brute-force DOM Scanning: Removed power-hungry getComputedStyle traversals and regex false-positive logic. Switched to declarative CSS injection, resulting in zero main-thread blocking.
- Fixed Scroll Lock: Resolved the issue where web pages were forcibly locked from scrolling after hiding cookie banners.
- Brand New Visual Experience: Updated with a newly designed HD application icon for DewSecure. Optimized the build pipelines for Firefox and Opera, achieving 100% code synchronization across all three platforms.

title: Cross-Browser Engine & Security Compliance
content: This update introduces a massive architectural shift to support multiple browsers seamlessly. We completely removed the heavy WASM and offscreen API dependencies, replacing them with a lightning-fast, purely local JavaScript AI inference engine. This drastically reduces the extension size and guarantees 100% compatibility across Chrome, Edge, Firefox, and Opera. Additionally, we hardened our security posture by completely removing all code obfuscation, removing unused permissions, and fixing critical XSS and URL reporting vulnerabilities to comply with strict store guidelines. The user feedback loop is now fully automated, allowing rapid rule adjustments without breaking your browsing experience.

title: Security Hardening & Performance Optimization
content: This update focuses on cross-device security and massive performance improvements. We have completely revamped the Device Limit enforcement system: when your account reaches the maximum number of devices, a sleek glass-morphism modal now seamlessly redirects you to the dashboard for un-binding. Furthermore, we optimized our build pipeline and dependency management, reducing the extension package size by over 80% (from 26MB to 5MB), resulting in lightning-fast installations and updates. We also fixed the Family Plan sub-account expiration date calculations and ensured flawless 9-language localization across all UI components.

title: Cross-Browser Support & UI Polish
content: This update introduces seamless cross-browser compatibility. While Chrome and Edge users continue to enjoy our premium Side Panel experience, DewSecure now automatically adapts to a Popup mode for browsers like Yandex. Additionally, we have added native Sidebar support for Opera users. More importantly, we optimized our AI training pipeline to intelligently extract third-party tracker domains from reported pages, avoiding false positives while continuously evolving the model.

title: AI Evolution & Stability Update
content: This massive update focuses on core stability and automated AI training. We completely fixed the data sync issues (X2 counting) and improved the whitelist bypass logic for a smoother browsing experience. More importantly, we've integrated a crowdsourced feedback loop (Missed Ad / False Block) that automatically fetches user data to retrain our AI model weekly. Your feedback now directly powers the next generation of DewSecure.

title: The Commercial Readiness Release
content: We are thrilled to announce that DewSecure core engine is now officially in v1.2.0. This update includes our brand new AI model with an impressive F1 score of 0.9185. We've also integrated a seamless Offscreen Document architecture to ensure zero lag while browsing.

title: Security Gateway Hardened
content: We have completely removed all hardcoded credentials from the client side. All model downloads are now fully protected via a Cloudflare Worker authorization gateway using pre-signed URLs. Security first, always.
